iconicAnchor.label: Dark-mode media interface with selective emissive accents
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: Platform guidance establishes dark appearance as a complete interface state in which controls, content, hierarchy, and contrast are designed for a low-light field rather than decorated with arbitrary neon.

sources.title: Dark Mode
supports: A dark interface applies a dark palette across screens, views, menus, and controls while preserving perceptual contrast.
Foreground content, icons, images, and active controls need deliberate adaptation rather than simple color inversion.

sources.title: Understanding Success Criterion 1.4.3: Contrast (Minimum)
supports: Text and images of text require sufficient luminance contrast against their actual background.
Hue and saturation alone do not provide reliable legibility, making light-dark structure essential when neon colors are used.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches neon, neon chroma, interface signal, digital signal, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/neon-night-ui/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
